rundown: Alejandro Tabilo beat Lorenzo Sonego in sets: 7-6, 6-7, 7-5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 11, 7:04 AM ET. It had Lorenzo Sonego 43% and Alejandro Tabilo 57%.

Final: Lorenzo Sonego 1 – Alejandro Tabilo 2. Right winner: it had Alejandro Tabilo at 57%.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: Alejandro Tabilo to win: the algo gave it 57%, THE PICK — won.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body: Flagged going in: there were no odds to check the projection against.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body: The result goes into both players' Elo ratings at the next data run, so their next match is priced on it.
